comparison.calculator: Bounded constant integer work, no allocation; explicit64-bit multiplies and validated32-bit division.
comparison.model: One input/counter event is O(1); test histories are bounded enumeration.
comparison.target: Fixed register sequence; capture is one bounded poll, not an acquisition queue or ISR latency bound.
comparison.measurement: Host-only exact rational interval analysis; not a target runtime dependency.

limits: Emitted section sizes and compiler local frames are observed; local frames are not complete call-chain/interrupt peak stack.
No physical waveform, skew, capture latency or energy measured.
Different optimization/targets require rebuilding; these are not portable golden costs.
